note.question: When will farmers form and patronize a cooperative alongside an investor-owned buyer, and how do open versus closed membership change farm-gate prices, entry, output, and farmer welfare?
note.overview: A conventional investor-owned firm moves first on farm-gate price, farmers strategically choose membership/sales channel, and a cooperative may enter and choose market quantity; the equilibrium is solved backward.
